query_text_by_family.forward_one: MATCH (n:Entity {node_id: $node_id})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(m:Entity) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
query_text_by_family.reverse_one: MATCH (n:Entity {node_id: $node_id})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(m:Entity) RETURN m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
query_text_by_family.reverse_two: MATCH (n:Entity {node_id: $node_id})<-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..2]-(m:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT m.node_id AS node_id ORDER BY node_id
